File: BagOverlay-v1.2.0.zip (18.1 KB)

A Lord of the Rings Online UI plugin that displays your backpack inventory grouped by category in a floating overlay window.

Description

BagOverlay adds a small draggable icon to your screen. Clicking it opens an overlay that shows all items currently in your backpack organised into categories such as Weapons Armor Jewelry Consumables Crafting Materials and more. This makes it easy to get a quick overview of your inventory without opening the default bag interface.

If you are an altaholic like me you have spent countless hours logging characters in and out looking for where you put crafting supplies or trophies. item.description:
Version: 1.3
Author: Thurallor
Category: Bags Bank & Inventory
Updated: 2017-08-03 10:03 UTC
Downloads: 42,566
File: BagDescrambler_v1.3.zip (6.4 KB)

Introduction
This plugin allows you to unscramble the slot IDs in your inventory bags.

The slot IDs are scrambled each time you use the Sort button in your inventory bags because of the odd way Turbine chose to implement the Sort feature.

Normally the slot IDs dont matter but some plugins e.g. SequenceBars that want to put stuff into specific bag locations have to rely on the slot ID numbers. Its easier to do this if the slot IDs are in order in your bags.

item.description:
Version: 1.02a
Author: Garan
Category: Bags Bank & Inventory
Updated: 2013-03-20 23:07 UTC
Downloads: 105,647
File: ItemTracker ver 1.02a.zip (41.4 KB)

Item Tracker is a Wallet style display of tracked item quantities for your current character as well as all alts vault and shared storage. You can create multiple tracking windows for tracking various types of items. Each item entry displays your current character quantity on the left a mini version of the item icon in the center and the total quantity of all characters on the right. You can choose to hide the current quantity or the total quantity columns.

You can also decide to hide the entry until the quantity reaches a specific threshold. Four statuses are defined Critical Low...

This plugin is a tool to display & search inventories of your rerolls


To install download and unzip into your plugins directory <<Documents>>The Lord of the Rings OnlinePlugins
A directory <<Documents>>The Lord of the Rings OnlinePluginsKiki will be created.

Load this plugin on all your characters using a plugin manager or the plugin manager option of the character selection screen.

Use /inv to display the plugins window or /inv text to search for text and display results in the chat window.
